document.abstract: (1.1) This practice specifies the environmental and surround conditions that are required in television or video program review areas for the consistent and critical evaluation of 525-line, 59.94-field television signals and other video program material at different technical facilities on properly aligned color picture monitors. (1.2) This practice also is designed to provide for repeatable color grading or correction and the rendering of subjective assessments when used with RP 167.
